name: Yaku Tsuu ~Noroi no Game~
source:
A game company has released a title only for it to be received coldly by the press. The company's president disappears soon after, and mysterious deaths begin to occur. 

[From [url=http://endaso.blogspot.ru/2014/03/playstation-horror-sound-novels.html]endaso[/url]]
translation:
一家游戏公司推出了一款作品，却遭到媒体冷遇。公司总裁不久后失踪，神秘死亡事件也开始接连发生。

[摘自[url=http://endaso.blogspot.ru/2014/03/playstation-horror-sound-novels.html]endaso[/url]]
